Half Neck.name: Half Neck
Half Neck.special: If success, incapacitates the head, neck and one arm. Escape requires skill versus roll vs AGL or STR Save (once per 3 sec).

Full Neck.name: Full Neck
Full Neck.special: If success, incapacitates the head, neck and both arms. Escape requires skill versus roll vs AGL Save (once per 5 sec).

Arm.name: Arm
Arm.special: If success, incapacitates one arm. Escape requires skill versus roll vs Half AGL Save (once per 3 sec).

Leg.name: Leg
Leg.special: If success, incapacitates one leg. Escape requires skill versus roll vs Half AGL Save (once per 4 sec).

Torso.name: Torso
Torso.special: If success, incapacitates one torso. Escape requires skill versus roll vs Quarter AGL Save (once per 5 sec).

Torso(1 Arm).name: Torso(1 Arm)
Torso(1 Arm).special: If success, incapacitates one torso and one arm. Escape requires skill versus roll vs Quarter AGL Save (once per 5 sec).

Torso(2 Arms).name: Torso(2 Arms)
Torso(2 Arms).special: If success, incapacitates one torso and both arms. Escape requires skill versus roll vs Quarter AGL Save (once per 5 sec).
